mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases > 0.2pp and PAYEMS decreases > 10k in the last month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises >0.2pp and PAYEMS falls >10k (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes increase the risk-free rate, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it signals a contraction in the industrial sector, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 400000 million dollars, it signals weak consumer demand, increasing recession fears and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 400000 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1000) and industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals a broad economic slowdown, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000 and INDPRO < 95 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).
